summary: At this source revision tests/lockfile-cold/run.sh detects the GS2-08.9 retirement boundary and execs tests/gs2-08-9-dispatch-repair/run.sh before its historical NuGet/source-exclusion legs. A successful invocation therefore qualifies the current read-only/local-only retirement route, not the old library-packs mechanism. For a shared FSharp.Core source update, independently qualify the SDK default (bundled package present), explicit DisableImplicitLibraryPacksFolder exclusion (empty-only feed cannot restore), and a project inheriting the shipped props (same refusal). Keep the historical workflow sealed; do not infer these controls ran from the old runner header or exit status. The shipped props exclusion and real cold public-feed lock restores remain separate source checks. This observation does not authorize new native or publication operations.
title: The retired cold-lock entrypoint does not execute its historical source-exclusion legs
